name: De Jong Attractor
desc: A luminous Peter de Jong strange attractor accumulated into a rolling log-density histogram and tone-mapped into a filamentary cloud whose coefficients slowly morph as the whole form drifts and rotates, rendered as additive plasma glow, thermal false-color, sumi ink on paper, a cyan density blueprint, or pearlescent iridescent nacre.

energy.doc: exposure / glow amplitude + iteration count (primary look control)

scale.doc: attractor zoom vs frame (higher = bigger filamentary cloud)

density.doc: iterated points accumulated per frame (cloud fullness)

persist.doc: density-buffer persistence (0 = crisp/live, 1 = long luminous smear)

style.doc: render philosophy: additive plasma glow / thermal false-color / sumi ink on paper / cyan density blueprint / iridescent nacre

seed.doc: De Jong coefficient basin + palette phase (deterministic)

alpha.doc: opacity for VJ compositing (100 = opaque bg, lower = translucent field)

act.doc: multi-minute dramaturgy: gentle breathe / intensity-driven surge / glacial drift
